description: A four-way switch for signals that only ever changes over where two signals momentarily hold the same voltage, so the output never steps

params.text: Takes every crossing that comes up, ignoring CROSSING and both rows' knobs
Allows a changeover only where both signals are moving the same way, so a rising signal is swapped only for another rising signal
The chance that any one crossing of two signals is taken, none fully left and every crossing fully right
Forces the output onto this row's signal at once, whatever the two voltages are doing
Scales the chance of a changeover away from this row's signal, never fully left and the full CROSSING chance fully right
Scales the chance of a changeover onto this row's signal, never fully left and the full CROSSING chance fully right

inputs.text: Allows changeovers onto this row's signal while the voltage here is at or above 5V and blocks them below that; with nothing patched the row is allowed
A rising edge above 1V forces the output onto this row's signal at once, whatever the two voltages are doing
One of the four signals the output can be taken from; the crossing test only ever moves the output onto it while it has a cable in it

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse each time the output changes over to a different signal
The selected signal, passed through unchanged
10V while the output is being taken from this row's signal, and 0V otherwise

notes: a changeover can only happen where two signals come within 0.01V of each other, so signals that never cross will never swap however high the chance is set.
a row with nothing patched to its SHAPES jack is never reached by the crossing test; its SELECT button forces the output onto that row anyway, where it reads 0V.
after a crossing is declined that row is barred until the two voltages move more than 0.011V apart, so one slow crossing is offered once rather than at every sample.
